summary: Container enterprise topology: each VM 16 GB RAM, 4 CPUs, 60 GB disk, 3000 IOPS. VMs: 2 gateway, 2 controller, 2 hub and 2 EDA (gateway, hub and EDA with colocated Redis), 1 hop node, 2 execution nodes, external database and an external HAProxy load balancer. Redis HA needs 6 VMs (not on execution or DB nodes); external Redis is not supported for containerized AAP.
questions: How many VMs does the container enterprise topology need?
Where can Redis be colocated in containerized AAP?
Is external Redis supported for containerized AAP?
How many VMs are needed for Redis high availability?

answer_card.title: Container enterprise topology
answer_card.answer_md:
Each VM: 16 GB RAM, 4 CPUs, 60 GB disk, 3000 IOPS.

| VMs | Role |
|---|---|
| 2 | Platform gateway + Redis |
| 2 | Automation controller |
| 2 | Private automation hub + Redis |
| 2 | Event-Driven Ansible + Redis |
| 1 | Mesh hop node |
| 2 | Mesh execution nodes |
| 1 | External database |
| 1 | External HAProxy load balancer |

Redis HA needs 6 VMs (never on execution nodes or the database). External Redis is not supported.
